trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوْبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْاَبْرَارِ۔ رَبَّنَا وَآتِنَا مَا وَعَدْتَنَا عَلٰى‌ رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيْعَادَ۔ رَبَّنَا اَمَتَّنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ وَاَحْيَيْتَنَا اثْنَتَيْنِ فَاعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوْبِنَا فَهَلْ اِلٰى‌ خُرُوْجٍ مِنْ سَبِيْلٍ۔‌ رَبَّنَا اصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ اِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا۔

lines.rarabic: RABBANAA AA-MANNAA FAGH-FIR-LANAA ZONOO-BANAA WA KAFFIR A’NNAA SAIYYE-AATE-NAAWA TAWAF-FANAA MA-A’L AB-RAARE. RABBANAA WA AATE-NAA MAA WA-A’D-TANAA A’LAA ROSOLE-KA WA LAA TUKH-ZENAA YAUW-MAL QIYAAMATE INNA-KA LAA TUKH-LE-FUL MEE-A’ADA. RABBANAA A-MATTA-NAS NA-TAIY-NE WA AH-YAYTA-NAS NA-TAIY-NE FA’TARAF-NAA BE-ZONOO-BE-NAA FA-HAL ILAA KHOROO-JIN MIN SABEE-LIN. RABBA-NAS-RIF A’NNAA A’ZAABA JAHANNAMA INNA A’ZAABA-HAA KAANA GHARAA-MAN.

trans.en: Our Lord! We have heard the call of one calling (Us) to Faith, Believe your in the Lord, and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins, blot out from us our iniquities, and take to Yourself our souls in the company of the righteous. Our Lord! Grant us what You didst promise unto us through Your apostles and save us from shame on the Day of Judgment: For You never break Your promise. Our Lord! Twice Thou has made us without life, and twice Thou has given us Life! Now have we established our sins: Is there any way out (of this)? …Our Lord! In You do we trust, and to You do we turn in repentance: to You is (our) Final Goal. Our Lord! Make us not a (test and) trial for the Unbelievers, but forgive us, our Lord! For You are the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ اَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ اَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِيْنَ اِمَامًا۔ رَبَّنَا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنَا وَاِلَيْكَ اَنَبْنَا وَاِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيْرُ۔ رَبَّنَا لَا تَجْعَلْنَا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَلِاِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِيْنَ سَبَقُوْنَا بِالْاِيْمَانِ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ فِيْ قُلُوْبِنَا غِلًّا لِلَّذِيْنَ آمَنُوْا۔ رَبَّنَا اِنَّكَ رَؤُفٌ رَّحِيْمٌ‌ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِهٖ وَاسْتُرْ عَلَيَّ ذُنُوْبِيْ وَعُيُوْبِيْ وَاغْفِرْ لِيْ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ اِنَّكَ الرَّءُوْفُ الرَّحِيْمُ۔

lines.rarabic: RABBANAA HAB LANAA MIN AZ-WAAJE-NAA WA ZURRIY-YAATE-NAA QURRATA A’YO-NIN WAJ-A’L-NAA LIL-MUTTA-QEENA IMAA-MAN. RABBANAA A’LAIY-KA TAWAKKAL-NAA WA ILAIY-KA A-NAB-NAA WA ILAIY-KAL MASEERO. RABBANAA LAA TAJ-A’L-NAA FITNA-TAN LIL-LAZEENA KAFAROO RABBA-NAGH-FIR LANAA ZONOO-BANAA WA LE-IKH-WAANE-NAL LAZEENA SABA-QOONAA BIL-IMAANE WA LAA TAJ-A’L FEE QOLOO-BENAA GHILLAN LIL-LAZEENA AA-MANOO. RABBANAA RAOO-FUR RAHEE-MOON SALLE A’LAA MOHAMMADIW WA AALE-HI WAS-TUR A’LAIYYA ZONOO-BEE WA O’YOO-BEE WAGH-FIR LEE BE-HAQQE MOHAMMADIW WA AALE MOHAMMADIN INNA-KAR RAOO-FUR RAHEEMO.

trans.en: Our Lord! Avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous. Our Lord! Grant unto us wives and offspring who will be the comfort of our eyes and give us (the grace) to lead the righteous. Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who came before us into the Faith, and leave not in our hearts, rancour (or sense of injury) against those who have believed. Our Lord! You are indeed Full of Kindness, Most Merciful. Conceal our sins and defects and forgive us for the sake of Muhammad (s.a.w.a) and his progeny (a.s) surely you are most gracious and merciful.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
